create_llm_provider: create an LLMProvider dataclass instance with name, display_name, models, and env_var for configuring an LLM backend
build_search_providers: build a list of SearchProvider entries for DuckDuckGo, Tavily, InfoQuest, Exa, and Firecrawl search backends
configure_web_fetch_providers: configure WebProvider instances for Jina AI, Exa, InfoQuest, and Firecrawl web fetching tools
list_llm_providers: list available LLMProviders including OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, vLLM, Codex, and Claude Code
summarize_provider_configs: summarize the LLM, search, and web fetch provider configurations with their env_var requirements and extra_config settings
